items.title: INS Sudarshini Completes Port Visit to Antigua
items.whyInNews: The Indian Navy's sail training ship, INS Sudarshini, completed its port visit to Antigua on June 2, 2026. The ship was on a visit to the Caribbean island nation as part of its ongoing deployment to the region.
items.summary: The visit was aimed at strengthening bilateral ties between India and Antigua and Barbuda. During the visit, the crew of INS Sudarshini engaged in various activities, including professional interactions with the Antigua and Barbuda Defence Force. The ship also conducted a community service event at a local school. INS Sudarshini is commanded by Captain Atrayu Sekhar and has a crew of 158 personnel.

items.title: Rudra M-II Air-to-Surface Missile Successfully Tested

items.summary: The test was conducted at a firing range in Rajasthan and was witnessed by senior officials from the DRDO and the IAF. The missile has a range of over 100 km and can be launched from a variety of platforms, including fighter jets and helicopters.

items.title: USTR Proposes Additional Duties on India and 53 Other Countries
items.whyInNews: The United States Trade Representative (USTR) has proposed 12.5% additional duties on India and 53 other countries over forced labour import violations, as announced on June 2, 2026.
items.summary: The USTR has proposed 12.5% additional duties on India and 53 other countries due to forced labour import violations. The proposed duties aim to curb the practice of forced labour in these countries.
